reasoning_content:
The server code is mixed ESM/CommonJS. The simplest fix is to ADD back "type": "module" - but this causes other issues.

Actually, looking at the old logs from before I made changes - the server WAS working! It says "Postgres save skipped (database not configured)" which means it was running but couldn't save to the database.

The issue is that Node 22 has stricter ESM handling. Let me check if there's a different Node version we can use, or just add the type: module back.

Actually wait - let me re-read the original error. The error was from /opt/areloria/server/package.json which still had "type": "module" in the old broken version. But when I fixed the package.json I removed it. 

But the code itself uses ESM features (import.meta) so it NEEDS type: module!

Let me add it back:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Add type: module back
sftp = client.open_sftp()

# Fix root package.json
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "r") as f:
    content = f.read().decode()

import json
data = json.loads(content)
data["type"] = "module"
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
print("Added type: module to root")

# Fix server package.json
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "r") as f:
    content = f.read().decode()

data = json.loads(content)
data["type"] = "module"
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
print("Added type: module to server")

sftp.close()

# Rebuild
print("\n=== Rebuild ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -5")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Start
print("\n=== Starting ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 10 && pm2 list")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
